app_name: SkillMatch - Campus Event & Volunteer Management System
context: College campus event management and volunteer skill-matching platform with organizers and volunteers, skill matching, attendance tracking, and downloadable completion certificates.
theme: Light mode primary with vibrant academic and professional campus-event style (Archetype 3 Pastel/Soft + Archetype 6 Vibrant Play blend)
components: Navbar with Role Switcher (Organizer vs Volunteer)
Organizer Dashboard (Manage events, view signups, mark attendance/completion)
Volunteer Dashboard (My events, skills profile, earned certificates)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive, polished full-stack application with SQLite database (seeded with demo users and events), FastAPI backend, and React frontend. Ensure all buttons, inputs, and interactive elements have test IDs and accessible states. Include the requested role switcher, skill matching, attendance tracking, and downloadable completion certificates.
